```swift /// Presents the rating and review request view after a two-second delay. private func presentReview() { Task { // Delay for two seconds to avoid interrupting the person using the app. try await Task.sleep(for: .seconds(2)) await requestReview() } } ```
segments.contextBefore: The conditions above exist purely to delay the call to `requestReview`, so days, weeks, or even months can elapse without the app prompting a user for a review.
segments.contextAfter: Techniques to delay the call are valuable because they cause an app to show a review request when people are more experienced at using the app and can provide better feedback.

The app presents the rating and review request view if the person completed the three-step process at least four times and its current version is different from the version that last prompted them for review. */ if processCompletedCount >= 4, currentAppVersion != lastVersionPromptedForReview { presentReview() // The app already displayed the rating and review request view. Store this current version. lastVersionPromptedForReview = currentAppVersion } ```
